findings: No intracranial haemorrhage, oedema, mass effect or midline shift. Preserved grey-white matter differentiation throughout the cerebral hemispheres, basal ganglia and brainstem. The ventricles and sulci are normal in size and configuration for age. No extra-axial collection. The visualised paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells are clear.
impression: No acute intracranial haemorrhage or mass effect on this non-contrast study. Early ischaemic change is not excluded.
recommendations: Clinical correlation. Consider CT angiography with perfusion if the patient remains within the intervention window, or MRI with diffusion-weighted imaging.
follow_up: None. If the deficit persists, the MRI recommended above is the next study rather than a further CT.
